inlines.v: ADIAPH'ORISTS, noun [Gr. indifferent.] Moderate Lutherans; a name given in the sixteenth century, to certain men that followed Melancthon, who was more pacific than Luther The adiaphorists held some opinions and ceremonies to be indifferent, which Luther condemned as sinful or heretical.
